newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ATI facility handles first wheat shipment.
newsitem.headline: ATI facility handles first wheat shipment.

text.p: Port operator and cargo handler Asian Terminals Inc said on Monday it has received and discharged its first wheat shipment.
In a statement, ATI said it unloaded a total of 33,841 tonnes of imported wheat from the United States last month through its newly-opened Mariveles grain terminal, in Bataan, northern Philippines.
The terminal achieved an average unloading rate of 14,186 tonnes daily, faster than its guaranteed rate of 10,000 tonnes per day for wheat shipment, the company said.
